trophies.guide: The Platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the 54th other trophy unlocks. There is no separate task behind it — finish the story, clear the 100% checklist and sweep the cleanup, and it is yours.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: it pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; the Platinum unlocks on its own the moment the last one pops.
Play through all five story chapters first — 12 story trophies pop along the way.
Clear the 100% Completion checklist after the credits; that is the longest single requirement.
Sweep the remaining side strands, activities and one-off feats in free-roam.

trophies.guide: The very first mission of the game. Gone Fishing opens Chapter 1 and teaches the basics — just play it through to the end and the trophy is yours.
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy: unmissable, pops at the end of the opening mission.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.t: Start a new game; the opening mission Gone Fishing begins Chapter 1.
Follow the on-screen prompts through the mission beats.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends; nothing here can be failed for good.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The chapter closes after its last mission, and the trophy pops as the next chapter begins. Do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before the chapter ends.
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy: unmissable, pops when Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.t: Complete Chapter 1 — the trophy's requirement is finishing the chapter.
Play the Chapter 1 missions through to the last one, What's in the Bag?
The trophy pops as Chapter 1 closes and Chapter 2 begins.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. After the Coffee Break mission you can play as both characters and roam together, which also opens the partner trophies.
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy: unmissable, pops when Chapter 2 ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.t: Complete Chapter 2 — the trophy's requirement is finishing the chapter.
Play the Chapter 2 missions through to the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.
The trophy pops as Chapter 2 closes; after Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. This is the chapter where Vice City opens up: the Key Cloner, the Dye Pack Jammer, Yasmani's jewelry jobs and the fences all unlock here.
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy: unmissable, pops when Chapter 3 ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.t: Complete Chapter 3 — the trophy's requirement is finishing the chapter.
Play the Chapter 3 missions through to the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
The trophy pops as Chapter 3 closes; Chapter 3 also unlocks the Key Cloner and the fences.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Take the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… when it appears — it unlocks the bank-vault robberies you need later.
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy: unmissable, pops when Chapter 4 ends.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.t: Complete Chapter 4 — the trophy's requirement is finishing the chapter.
Play the Chapter 4 missions through to the final one, Starting From Zero.
The trophy pops as Chapter 4 closes; do the optional That's Where The Money Is… mission on the way.

trophies.guide: Finish the story. The final mission ends Chapter 5 and rolls the credits; after them, free-roam continues and the 100% checklist appears under Progress.
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy: unmissable, pops when the final mission ends.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Complete the final mission — the trophy's requirement is finishing the story.
Play Chapter 5 through to the final mission and finish it.
The trophy pops at the end of the final mission; free-roam and the 100% checklist open after the credits.

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so it comes to you as you play through the chapter — no preparation needed.
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy: unmissable, pops during the Breakfast Run mission.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.t: Reach the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run — the trophy's requirement is completing it.
Play the Breakfast Run mission through to the end.
The trophy pops during the mission; it cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. It is one of the big set-piece missions of the chapter and comes up naturally in the story.
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy: unmissable, pops during The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.t: Reach the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist — the trophy's requirement is completing it.
Play The Cartel Heist through to the end.
The trophy pops during the mission; it cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It arrives as part of the story, so just keep playing the chapter.
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy: unmissable, pops during the Child's Play mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.t: Reach the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play — the trophy's requirement is completing it.
Play Child's Play through to the end.
The trophy pops during the mission; it cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Like every story trophy, it unlocks as you play the mission — there is nothing extra to do.
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy: unmissable, pops during the Headliners mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.t: Reach the Chapter 4 mission Headliners — the trophy's requirement is completing it.
Play Headliners through to the end.
The trophy pops during the mission; it cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. It is a story mission, so it finds you as the chapter unfolds.
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy: unmissable, pops during the VCIA Takedown mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.t: Reach the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown — the trophy's requirement is completing it.
Play VCIA Takedown through to the end.
The trophy pops during the mission; it cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies and comes up as the final chapter builds to its ending.
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy: unmissable, pops during Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.t: Reach the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory — the trophy's requirement is completing it.
Play Operation Savage Glory through to the end.
The trophy pops during the mission; it cannot be missed.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game, and the longest. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — and anything you did during the story already counts toward it. The list is forgiving: it is closer to 60% true completion, not a demand to do literally everything.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the checklist opens after the story and everything on it stays available in free-roam.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.t: Finish the story; the 100% Completion checklist then appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion.
Work the checklist in free-roam: every robbery, every underwater discovery, every shooting range and every drone race is required.
Complete any 70 of the 80 challenges — you may skip the ten hardest.
Finish the collectible parts: 15 of the 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals.
The checklist is about 60% true completion, so do not chase everything — clear what it lists and the trophy pops at 100%.

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida count. There are four kinds — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps — and you can mix them freely. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: stunts can be done any time in free-roam.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.t: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game; the four kinds are 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Mix the kinds freely — only the total of 250 matters, so pick the easiest ones first.
Flights under bridges are the quickest: fly low under any bridge and it counts.
Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts; the map also lists stunt spots by name.
The 100% checklist asks for 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you want the Platinum.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do one of each of the nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Most of them come up on their own while you play; the map marks activities with blue icons.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: every activity type stays available in free-roam.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.t: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
Check what you have done under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities — it shows the count per type.
Use the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) to find any type you have not tried yet.
You will do most types automatically while working on the other trophies, so leave this one until late and mop up the rest.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The challenges are short and the gold medals are not too hard — take your time, use the right weapon for each challenge, and retry any you miss.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the ranges stay open in free-roam.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.t: Visit the 12 Shooting Ranges; between them they hold 42 challenges.
Earn a gold medal in every challenge — the 100% checklist needs all 42 as well.
Retry any challenge you miss; the ranges never close and there is no penalty for failing.
The trophy pops when the last gold medal lands.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, and the 100% checklist needs every one of them — so winning one per location is the easy half of the job.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: drone races stay available in free-roam.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.t: Find the Top Fun drone races — there are 14 locations with 42 races between them.
Win at least one race at every location; the trophy needs one win per location, not all 42.
All 42 races are needed for the 100% checklist, so keep racing after the trophy pops.
The trophy pops when you win at the fourteenth location.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations. Winning the same race twice does not count — you need 20 distinct wins, so keep moving to new races.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: races stay available in free-roam.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: Win 20 different races — there are 40 unique race locations in the game.
Winning the same race twice does not count; each win must be at a race you have not won before.
Race types count together, so mix car races, Top Fun drone races and other race challenges.
The trophy pops on your twentieth distinct race win.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal at fishing. You meet Cal in Chapter 1, and after that he texts you a fishing challenge with a purple marker west of Key Lento. Go there and out-fish him.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Cal's challenge stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.t: Meet Cal during the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui — the fishing challenge comes after that.
Wait for Cal's text; it marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map west of Key Lento.
Go to the marked spot and take on Cal's fishing challenge.
Beat Cal in the challenge and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. You only need to reach the end of one game once — no need to beat every challenge in it.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the arcade games stay playable after the story.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.t: There are four arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers — you can do this from Chapter 1.
Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines out in the world.
Finish all the levels of any one game once; you do not need to beat its extra challenges.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's five quests. The strand is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when Andy calls Lucia and texts her an address in Belville. All five quests stay available after the story.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Andy's quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.t: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3; Andy calls and then texts her home address, marking the strand in Belville.
Andy's strand is Lucia-only — Jason cannot take these quests.
Complete the five Andy quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
The trophy pops when the fifth and final Andy quest ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear Kenton's seven shipwrecks. His strand starts in Chapter 1 after the Island Dreams mission; he marks treasure chests on the map, you dive for them with the metal detector and bring them back. Kenton goes quiet for a while in the story, but he always comes back.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Kenton returns after the story and his quests stay open.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.t: Kenton's strand starts in Chapter 1, a while after the Island Dreams mission; he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento.
He marks purple treasure chest icons on the map; dive to each shipwreck and dig the treasure up with the metal detector.
Bring the treasures back to Kenton; after each set he calls you back and marks more locations — seven shipwrecks in total.
Track progress under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, or under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.
If Kenton goes quiet mid-story, keep playing — he texts Jason again in Chapter 2–3 and his quests return.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five jobs. The strand opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. All five jobs stay available after the story.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Billy's jobs stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; Billy's strand is then marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete the five Billy jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
The Impaler job asks you to steal the Impaler — the other jobs are rides along with Billy.
The trophy pops when the fifth and final Billy job ends.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight Strangers & Freaks strands — but only certain strangers count. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not. The strands stay open after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: every stranger strand stays available in free-roam.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.t: Find Strangers & Freaks side quests in the open world — but only some questlines count toward this trophy.
Confirmed to count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries).
Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not count as strangers for this trophy — their strands have their own trophies.
Track your count in the trophy list's tracker; finish any eight qualifying strands.
More qualifying strangers are still being found, so check back if you are stuck on the last one.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's wish list. It starts in Chapter 3, when the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS teaches you the Key Cloner and you steal a Zorrusso for Randy. After that he hands you the list — steal the cars, scan them with WAiNK to check them against the list, and drive each one to his garage in west Vice City.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Randy's wish list stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.t: Play the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS; it unlocks the Key Cloner and starts Randy's Wish List with the Zorrusso.
Randy wants 16 sports cars in total; track them under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if a car is on the list before you steal it.
Drive each car to Randy's garage (green RK icon, west Vice City); a car delivered in good condition pays more.
Randy marks some cars for you in fixed locations — sports cars also turn up around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's two quests. The strand is Jason-only and starts in Chapter 3 after the mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point you at the Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy the labs, and Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Tyrone's labs stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.t: Play as Jason in Chapter 3; after the mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers point at the Synthetic Labs in Vice City.
Tyrone's strand is Jason-only — Lucia cannot take these quests.
Destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter until Tyrone gives you the second quest.
Complete Spin On This — shutting down the labs — and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations, with both Jason and Lucia — meditating with both at one spot counts twice. This is the one trophy that might be missable: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, never comes back. Do it the morning after the Down to Earth mission, when Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen — follow her to the balcony and accept.
trophies.missableNote: Possibly missable: the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house is only offered in Chapter 1. Whether it counts toward the trophy is still unconfirmed, so do it anyway.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.t: Do the Chapter 1 meditation before the chapter ends: after the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept.
There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditate at each with both Jason and Lucia, which counts as two per spot.
Track meditations under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.
The last spot needs both characters playable together, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
It is still unconfirmed whether the Chapter 1 meditation is required for the trophy — PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it anyway.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt for Bret Vogel. His strand starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason gets a text from Bret and meets him in Lummox County for the quest Veteran Hunted. Bret then marks hunting spots on the map; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed — work the whole strand.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Bret's strand stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.t: Play as Jason after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; Bret's text marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County.
Bret's strand is Jason-only — Lucia cannot receive his message.
Meet Bret, then follow the purple hunting markers he puts on the map and bring the animals back to him.
Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 in his first quest; a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required.
There are 15 Target Decks in total and all 15 are needed for 100%, so finish the whole strand — the exact animal that pops the trophy is still unconfirmed.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; the 100% checklist asks for 15 sets, so three is the easy part. Work from a card-set map and clear one set at a time.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: cards stay collectible in free-roam.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.t: There are 18 collectible card sets in the game; this trophy needs any 3 completed.
Cards are found across Leonida — use a card-set map and clear one set at a time.
The 100% checklist asks for 15 sets, so keep collecting after the trophy pops.
The trophy pops when your third set is complete.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app. Hold up on the D-pad to open WAiNK, then hold R1 on a landmark, curiosity or sculpture to scan it. There are far more than 100 scannable spots, so scan whatever you pass.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: WAiNK spots stay scannable in free-roam.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.t: Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold up on the D-pad), then look at a spot and hold R1 to scan it.
Any mix counts: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags — scan 100 of them in total.
There are more than 100 scannable spots, so it does not matter which ones you pick.
Start scanning from Chapter 1; scanning vehicles with WAiNK also feeds the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The challenges sit in eight groups of ten, and the 100% checklist needs 70 — so this trophy comes on the way. Pick the easiest challenges first and leave the nasty ones for last.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: challenges stay available in free-roam.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.t: There are 80 challenges in eight groups of ten; this trophy needs any 50 of them.
View and track them under Progress, then Challenges — the checkmark shows which are done.
Many challenges complete on their own while you work on the other trophies, so leave this one late.
Pick the easiest remaining challenges; the 100% checklist needs 70, so you can skip the ten hardest.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle to follow you on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: you can build a four-star wanted level any time in free-roam.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.t: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together and call your partner (hold right, then Triangle).
Cause enough trouble to reach a four-star wanted level with your partner beside you.
Escape through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you.
The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone, not just out of the flashing search area.
It also pops on its own during bank-vault robberies, which always bring a four-star wanted level.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Do it after Coffee Break, when you can call your partner. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well — rob a couple of items in each, break the safe with sticky bombs, and keep moving. The trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: shops can be robbed any time in free-roam.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.t: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, then call your partner (hold right, then Triangle).
Rob three robbery targets in a row (green icons) while keeping the red-blue flashing wanted level — never let it drop.
A good spot is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's jewelry jobs in Chapter 3.
In each store, rob a couple of items and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs; bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline.
The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop — if it does not, rob a fourth.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Stand on a busy road and scan passing vehicles with the WAiNK app — scanning is enough, you never have to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this trophy comes early.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: vehicles stay scannable in free-roam.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.t: Open the WAiNK app (hold up on the D-pad), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning alone discovers it.
Stand on a busy road and scan every passing vehicle; there are 557 vehicles at launch.
You do not need to drive a vehicle to discover it — a scan is enough.
Track discovered vehicles under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles; the 100% checklist wants 200 base models.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3+R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots light up, but the purple focus bar drains in seconds. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline to stretch it, and line up five enemies before you trigger it. An assault rifle like the Duke 556 works best. Note: it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Combat Focus can be used any time in free-roam.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Activate Combat Focus with L3+R3 while aiming a firearm — it slows time and highlights weak spots while the purple focus bar drains.
Buff your focus first: eat or drink, shower at home, and bring Adrenaline to extend the focus time.
Line up five enemies before triggering it — criminals at gang operations work well — and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556.
It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick criminal targets.
Focus has four levels and grows as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing — it gets easier late in the game.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport and fly it at least 1 km away. It has to be a plane connected to a boarding bridge — the planes parked out on the airfield do not work. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: VCIA stays open and the planes stay docked in free-roam.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.t: Go to VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and find a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal — the easiest is at terminals E3/E4.
It must be a plane connected to a boarding bridge; planes parked on the airfield do not count.
Drive through a fence around the airfield, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and enter the plane, or walk in through the terminal.
Go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport.
The unlock is slightly delayed — keep flying until the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank and take out enemies from inside it. The tanks stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and start shooting.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Mile Zero Air Station stays open in free-roam.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.t: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County.
The tanks stand in the south of the air base; drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.
The trophy pops from inside the tank — you do not need to drive it anywhere.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store through the back door without ever being detected. First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — that unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies on the map. Enter through the back, find the safe code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave quietly.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: jewelry stores can be robbed any time in free-roam.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; it unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons.
Break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun — kicking the door sets off the alarm.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code and use it to loot the safe.
Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room, then leave — the trophy pops shortly after.
A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. It starts with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it with your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans. Robbing a vault instantly gives a four-star wanted level, so escape fast on a motorcycle and switch cars to go unrecognized.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: bank vaults stay robbable in free-roam.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.t: Finish the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — it introduces bank-vault robberies and counts as your first vault.
Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then go in while the vault is open; bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone.
After the mission, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans (do his Payday Loans jobs first if he does not offer tips yet).
Rob any five of the eight large bank jobs; all eight are needed for the 100% checklist.
Each vault robbery brings a four-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing the truck. Or find a truck driving around Vice City near banks, block it, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — then escape the red heat radius.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: armored trucks keep driving in free-roam.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.t: The trophy comes free with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing the bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck.
Or find an armored truck driving around Vice City near banks and block its path.
Plant a sticky bomb on the truck's back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.
Escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. There are 52 areas in total.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the map can be unfogged any time in free-roam.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.t: Unfog the whole map — the trophy needs all 52 areas of Leonida explored.
The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog.
Work through the fogged regions one by one until the map is fully visible.
The trophy pops when the last area clears.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. There are 39 operations in total, marked by yellow icons when you go near them; the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this trophy comes on the way. Track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: gang operations stay available in free-roam.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.t: There are nine gangs and 39 illegal gang operations; this trophy needs one operation from each gang.
Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress.
Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs — it shows how many of their operations you have robbed.
All 39 operations are needed for the 100% checklist, so the trophy pops on the way.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it standing by the bar. That is the method PowerPyx reports — but be warned: other guides still list this trigger as unconfirmed, so if it does not pop, try again another night and keep an eye out for updates.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the bar stays open in free-roam.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar.
Drink it while standing next to the bar with the view — the trophy should pop.
Honest note: Vice City Hustle still lists this trigger as NOT CONFIRMED, so if it does not pop, try another visit and watch for updates.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only take the car after you get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. It only unlocks from this specific blue Banshee — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the showroom and the Banshee stay there in free-roam.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.t: Get the Key Cloner first, in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — you need it to take the car.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and find the blue Banshee.
Hack into the Banshee, then drive forward straight through the showroom window.
The pop is slightly delayed — keep driving away on the street until it unlocks. Only this blue Banshee works.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. You go there during the optional Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, grab the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway (code 0300, or blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police — and if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the Kingpin Bowling robbery respawns, so you can return for any item you missed.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.t: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — it is marked automatically during the optional Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office (golden icon).
Grab the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon).
Loot the safe in the north-east hallway — the code is 0300, or blow it up with sticky bombs.
Escape the police and the trophy pops. Missed an item? The robbery icon respawns later — you do not need all three in one go.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between characters. Work out together — call your partner along, and while you train with one character the other trains too, so you make double progress. Fitness clubs are all over Vice City; you can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: strength can be trained any time in free-roam.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.t: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between Jason and Lucia.
Buy a fitness club membership and work out — check Strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia.
Always bring your partner along (hold right, then Triangle): while you train with one character, the other trains too.
Max out Strength for both characters at the same time and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile), so every qualifying action flashes a small demon face on screen. Stealthy objectives and clean escapes push you toward Professional; killing pushes you toward Violent, Psycho — and Irredeemable, which is permanent, so do not farm it that way. Most players get this passively while finishing everything else.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: profile actions keep counting in free-roam.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.t: You need 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile; check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Turn on notifications first: Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile — a demon face flashes for each action.
Every robbery and enemy encounter counts; stealthy work pushes Professional, killing pushes Violent and Psycho.
Do not push toward Irredeemable — that profile is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight.
It happens passively while you finish the other trophies; if you are short at the end, rob and fight until the counter hits 500.

trophies.guide: Rob the same Payday Loans store Lucia robs in the Prologue — again, as Lucia, alone, and escape on foot. It only opens after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. Go to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, aim at the teller, take out the security, empty the three cash drawers, then run away on foot until it pops. Driving away does not count. Note: PowerPyx reports this method, while Vice City Hustle still lists the trigger as unconfirmed — so this is the best current lead, not a guarantee.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the Payday Loans store can be robbed again any time after Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer.
Go to the Payday Loans in Vice City, in Little Cuba, as Lucia — alone, without Jason.
Aim at the teller, take out the security, then steal the money from the three cash drawers.
Run away on foot until the trophy pops — it only unlocks if you escape on foot, not in a vehicle.
Honest note: this is PowerPyx's reported method; Vice City Hustle still lists the trigger as unconfirmed.

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods from the car, approach the UFO's bright blue light, and it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the UFO event can be retried in free-roam.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.t: Go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside — the spawn is slightly random, so drive away and return if it is not there.
Follow the path into the woods from the car until you see the UFO's bright blue light in the sky.
Approach the UFO; it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick ten pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach are the place to do it — keep riding through the crowd and kicking until the counter hits ten.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: bikes and pedestrians are everywhere in free-roam.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.t: Get on any bike in a crowded area — Vice City or Ocean Beach work best.
Kick pedestrians with Square while riding past them; you need ten within 60 seconds.
Keep riding through the crowd and kicking until the tenth one — the timer starts with the first kick.
If the timer runs out, ride to a fresh crowd and try again.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total across all robberies, not one delivery, and the bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: marked bills keep coming from robberies in free-roam.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans stores to collect marked bills.
Bring the bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
Deliver $250,000 in total; it counts across all robberies, not in one go.
Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so the total comes fast once vaults are open.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. It is a running total that builds naturally as you buy gear — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it, since they are the most expensive things in the shops.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: shops stay open in free-roam.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.t: Spend $100,000 in total across all types of shops — it is a running total.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to spend it, since they cost the most.
There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays and more to spend in.
It builds naturally as you gear up; check the trophy tracker to see how close you are.

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages — $160,000 in total. They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone. The four story-related garages do not count; only the eight you buy through the app do.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: garages stay for sale in free-roam.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses); the Vice City Real Estate app is then installed on your phone.
Buy the eight purchasable garages through the app — they cost $160,000 in total.
The four story-related garages do not count; only the eight bought garages do.
Robberies are the quickest way to raise the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, when you take a vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn. Each garage you own adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes), then drive stolen vehicles to Moses, choose Respray and Register — or register at a Pay 'n' Spray once you can handle tracked cars in Chapter 3. Cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: vehicles can be registered any time in free-roam.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses); the Scooter Bros app is then installed on your phone.
Buy enough garages first — each garage adds parking spots you need to register more vehicles.
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register in his garage.
At first Moses only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes until you reach ten.
